info.title: Printyx Universal Blog System — Public API
info.summary: API-key-authenticated read access to blog domain objects (US-BLOG-080).
info.description:
Public REST API for the Printyx Universal Blog System.

## Authentication
Every request authenticates with a workspace-scoped API key sent in the `X-Api-Key` header. The key is created via the admin endpoint `POST /api-keys` (JWT-gated) and is shown exactly once at creation; only a SHA-256 hash and a non-secret prefix are stored. The key resolves to a single tenant (workspace) and a set of read scopes.

## Rate limiting
Each key has a `rate_limit_per_minute`. Responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`. When the limit is exceeded the API returns `429` with `Retry-After: 60`.

## Scopes
Keys carry a subset of `keywords:read`, `briefs:read`, `posts:read`, `distributions:read`, `performance:read`. A request to a resource whose scope the key lacks returns `403`.

## Webhook HMAC verification (US-BLOG-079)
Webhook deliveries are POSTed to the configured consumer URL with headers:
- `X-Blog-Event`: the event type (e.g. `post.published`).
- `X-Blog-Delivery`: the delivery id (idempotency key — deliveries are at-least-once, so consumers MUST dedupe on this).
- `X-Blog-Signature`: `sha256=<hex>` where `<hex>` = HMAC-SHA256(webhook_secret, rawRequestBody).

Consumers verify by recomputing the HMAC over the raw body with their stored secret and comparing in constant time:
```ts
const expected = 'sha256=' + hmacSha256Hex(secret, rawBody);
if (!timingSafeEqual(expected, req.headers['x-blog-signature'])) reject();
```

## SDK generation
The TypeScript SDK is generated from this spec — it is not hand-written:
```bash
npx openapi-typescript supabase/functions/blog-platform-api/openapi.json \
  -o packages/blog-sdk/src/schema.d.ts
```
A thin `openapi-fetch` client wraps the generated types. Interactive docs deploy from this same file via Scalar (`@scalar/cli`) or Redocly (`redocly build-docs openapi.json`).

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Workspace-scoped API key (prefix `blogk_live_…`). Created via the JWT-gated admin endpoint; shown once. Resolves to a tenant + scopes.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this key.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current minute window.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (present on 429).

ListResponse.description: A page of records for the requested resource.

Forbidden.description: API key lacks the required scope.
